rules.title: SharePoint external sharing is limited to existing guests or people in the organization
rules.empty_message: SharePoint tenant settings could not be read
rules.description: External sharing for SharePoint must be limited to existing guests or only people in your organization (not 'Anyone' or 'New and existing guests').
rules.remediation: SharePoint admin center > Policies > Sharing: set external sharing for SharePoint to 'Existing guests' or 'Only people in your organization'.
rules.impact: Users cannot invite new external users or create Anyone links.

rules.title: External sharing is restricted to approved external domains
rules.empty_message: SharePoint tenant settings could not be read
rules.description: When external sharing is enabled it should be limited to an allow list of approved external domains.
rules.remediation: SharePoint admin center > Policies > Sharing > More external sharing settings: select 'Limit external sharing by domain' and 'Allow only specific domains', then add the approved domains. Not applicable when external sharing is disabled.
rules.impact: Sharing is only possible with the listed domains.

rules.title: SharePoint guest users cannot share items they do not own
rules.empty_message: SharePoint tenant settings could not be read
rules.description: External users should not be able to reshare files, folders and sites they do not own (PreventExternalUsersFromResharing in Get-SPOTenant; isResharingByExternalUsersEnabled in Graph).
rules.remediation: SharePoint admin center > Policies > Sharing > More external sharing settings: turn off 'Allow guests to share items they don't own'.

rules.title: Internal phishing protection for Microsoft Forms is enabled
rules.empty_message: Microsoft Forms tenant settings could not be read
rules.description: Microsoft Forms should scan forms and responses for phishing and block those that ask for sensitive information such as passwords.
rules.remediation: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft Forms: tick 'Add internal phishing protection'.

rules.title: Third-party storage services are restricted in Microsoft 365 on the web
rules.name: displayName
rules.empty_message: The 'Microsoft 365 on the web third-party storage' service principal was not found (the check fails when it is absent)
rules.description: The Microsoft 365 on the web third-party storage service principal (appId c1f33bc0-bdb4-4248-ba9b-096807ddb43e) must be disabled so users cannot open files stored in third-party storage in Microsoft 365 on the web.
rules.remediation: Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Microsoft 365 on the web: untick 'Let users open files stored in third-party storage services in Microsoft 365 on the web'.
rules.impact: Users cannot open files from third-party storage in Office on the web.
